summary.text: Winged Blade is Chanyu tribe's immortal killer move. Three Chanyu Gu Immortals can activate it together to break the wind veil of assimilation.

claims.text: Outside collapsing Imperial Court blessed land, Chanyu Tong Zu says the most important thing is to salvage the situation. Eighty-Eight True Yang Building was Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s arrangement, and these winds might not destroy it, so they should stay and look for a chance to help. An elderly wisdom path Gu Immortal calculates they have only one chance, and that the injury they cause would recover in only eight breaths of time. Tong Zu warns that Hei tribe, Ye Lui tribe, Dong Fang tribe, and Snowy Mountain have also sent Gu Immortals, so when they use the move they must prevent rivals from taking advantage.

A crisp blade sound reverberates. A huge opening appears in the wind veil of assimilation, showing the outside sky of Northern Plains. In the sky, three Chanyu tribe Gu Immortals are breathing roughly after activating the immortal killer move.

Fang Yuan judges that more than twenty Gu Immortals are present and that they probably used this immortal killer move. In his previous life it was a first class attacking method of Northern Plains, and during the battle of the five regions many Central Continent Gu Immortals died from it. Few methods can restrain the winds of assimilation. This move has peerless might and can cleave the wind veil open, though Fang Yuan notes the wind walls are still not too thick; given a longer period of time, even this move would be unable to damage it.

Seven Huang Jin elites form the ancient battle formation Seven Extreme Desolation, a three headed four armed black-gold giant. Its right arm moves like a blade and slashes at Duke Long. Duke Long’s pupils shrink; he feels a fatal danger.

The move has a very high reputation and is publicly recognized as the number one offensive method of Northern Plains’ Gu Immortal world. It can even cut apart the winds of assimilation temporarily. Duke Long dodges, but his right dragon horn is sliced apart and falls. The black-gold giant uses the move again while trying to bind him. He breaks free of the immortal binding rope and retreats, avoiding the second slash. The killer moves used by the seven are trump cards of their Huang Jin tribes, and this one is Chanyu tribe’s.
